title: 越南道教研究协会贺信
title_en: Vietnam Taoist Research Association Congratulatory Letter
body: 越南道教研究协会发来贺信，期待未来在道教研究与文化交流方面的深度合作。
body_en: The Vietnam Taoist Research Association sent congratulations, looking forward to future deep cooperation in Taoist research and cultural exchange.
